proposition: A 17th-century account places Ibn Turka and Sharaf al-Dīn in Baghdad seeking a Sufi master; Melvin-Koushki says to take it with grains of salt.

mediation.who: Abū l-Qāsim Kāzirūnī, Sullam al-Samāvāt, drawing on his teacher Afżal al-Dīn b. Ḥabīb Allāh Turka
mediation.note: written roughly two centuries after the events, via a Turka descendant
